_comment: AUTHORED conservation expectations for the sepsis estate (pinned 2026-09-06). Floors are deliberately NOT pinned here - they are round 2's HUMAN deliverable (gap_check_report.md, the ED-sepsis acceptance law); they pin after Sunny's verdict. This run landed the ADR 0025 posture: door 1 redacts contact shapes only, ids/names/dates count at intake and redact at egress - the sepsis corpus proved intake-redaction of config ids (FLO_MEAS_ID) destroys the logic's meaning and broke 8 parses. PACK 1.1 (2026-09-06): the 39 unresolved refs were ALL schema mismatches — the schema-less legacy dictionary + a dbo default; SCHEMA_OVERRIDES declared from the corpus's own consistent qualification; unresolved drops to 0 and the org tables join the working set. The remaining 164 unresolved are COLUMN refs into org-created tables and are TRUE upstream gaps, not engine defects: (a) org tables with zero/partial column metadata (IP_SepsisEncounters: 0 columns — Clarity's dictionary documents vendor tables, not org report tables); (b) renaming drift — the anonymization named dictionary columns (EncounterID/SepsisDate) differently from the SQL's (ENCOUNTER_ID/DATE_STAMP). Counted, never guessed; the DBA result tables diagnose each row. PACK 1.2 (2026-09-06): the §3c org-catalog part (demo-side: stub DDL stands in for the database catalog — OUR data-prep repair, customers read sys.columns) closed 164 -> 9; ALL 9 survivors are the READER/WRITER DRIFT class — SQL reading columns (DATE_STAMP, HS_FY) that neither dictionary nor catalog carries: the silently-failing-report finding, kept counted forever. 242 undocumented org-catalog columns counted as documentation gaps. GRAMMAR v1.3.0 (finding 3): scopes_with_decisions 142 -> 182 — forty scopes' ONLY filters lived in INNER-join ON clauses and were invisible until the #BPA corpse recovered the class; 87 outer-join match conditions counted, never voiced as membership.
